lines.text: What's next?
This baby right here is Crimson Crusaders. Pretty sweet, huh?
You don't have to tell me. I already know I'm awesome.
Huh. I'm an adult now. I don't eat candy.
Do I catch your eye?
What do you think, Commander? I've come a long way, haven't I? I bet I don't look like a little kid anymore!
Huh, what on earth is taking so long? Come back or I'm leaving!
Where are you? You said you wouldn't leave me alone...
Looks like I'm the only one here who knows what they're doing.
I'm bored. I'm going to see the AZX.
Are you coming to the railway station? Let's ride the AZX together!
You're lucky to have a Nikke like me who knows what she's doing.
Excellent! I've become more powerful!
Wow, getting stronger feels incredible!
Is that all? I want to keep getting stronger.
Is it really for me?
Thank... Thank you... Commander.
Well, thank you for your kindness.
I don't understand...whenever I see the Commander, I can't think straight! My heart feels like it's about to beat out of my chest.
Oh, what's happening? My heart feels funny...
You like me too, don't you Commander?
Well then, I'll just join this team!
What? Wh-what's wrong?!
You want me to go there?
Be careful, enemy incoming!
Let me show you what I can do!
I'm gonna try a few things out, that's all.
Get behind me! I'll protect you!
Finding a cover is part of strategy too, you know!
I'm still reloading, give me a second!
Drats, out of bullets!
I'm coming!
I'll take care of this, and you can take that to the bank!
You are going down!
You can run, but you can't hide!
You're done for!
C'mon, give me a real challenge!
Ouch!
Enough!
Ah!
I'm sorry... I'm so useless...
Nothing can stand in my way!
